title: Name Tap
user: Hard-of-hearing people in multilingual group conversations who need to notice when their name or a chosen urgent phrase is spoken.
smallest_useful_product: Android app that listens only while the user starts a local live-caption session, matches a small personal phrase list with fuzzy phonetic variants, and sends a distinct vibration/visual cue.
success_measure: In a controlled noisy-conversation test, users notice at least 90% of 20 spoken target-name events while reducing continuous screen watching.
constraints: On-device ASR only by default; clear consent screen for conversation capture; no claim of perfect recognition; comply with local recording/consent laws.
